title: E0123: XSS via echo
plain_english: Outputting user-controlled input directly with `echo`, `print`, or similar constructs without escaping can allow cross-site scripting (XSS).
why_matters: XSS vulnerabilities can: - Steal session cookies and authentication tokens - Perform actions on behalf of another user - Alter page content - Redirect users to malicious sites
what_it_checks: `<?= $var ?>` short echo tags with unescaped variables
